verdict.rationale: The pack has no first-party evidence of in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from the user's data. The MCP server exposes flags and observability data to external AI clients such as Cursor or Claude Code, which is a different capability from in-product AI. Guarded-rollout metric monitoring and Bayesian highlighting of the leading variation are statistical features, not AI-generated insights. The AI Runs and LLM-as-a-judge evals measure the customer's own AI rather than offering insights on the user's data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
